headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: The Hindu / Telangana Today / Times of India
bullets_en: Show cause notice to 137 medical shops in Hyderabad over illegal sale of habit-forming drugs.
Sangareddy: CITU demands Rs 42,000 minimum salary for industrial workers.
BJP steps up campaign for S.V. Sankanur in Hubballi.
France begins implementing agreement to protect Saudi oil facilities; what it means.
From the looms of Assam to the President’s wardrobe, Eri silk makes a mark.
bullets_ur: Hyderabad: Nasha-awar adwiyat ki ghair-qanooni farokht par 137 medical shops ko show cause notice jari.
Sangareddy: CITU ka sanati mazdooron ke liye kam az kam Rs 42,000 tankhwa ka mutalba.
Hubballi mein BJP ne S.V. Sankanur ke liye intikhabi muhim taiz kar di.
France ne Saudi tel tanseebat ke tahaffuz ke muahiday par amal shuru kar diya; iska kya matlab hai.
Assam ke looms se Sadar ke wardrobe tak, Eri silk ne apni numayan pehchan bana li.
